note: Generalized scan beyond BCZ's own rounds (see build-bounty-calendar.py for the BCZ-specific proof of concept). Confirms POID's on-chain/API `deadline` field is essentially unused in practice - only 0 of the bounties scanned had it set at all, even though many describe a clear deadline in free text. That gap is exactly why this tool exists.
